title: BuildScript: A Website Built from a Google Doc
summary: Stefano Casafranca shows BuildScript, which turns edits in a Google Doc into a website built by Claude Code.

chapters.title: Who He Is and What BuildScript Is
Demo: The Document Is the System

learn: The business owner edits a Google Doc that describes the site; after about 10 seconds with no activity, a daemon injects the change into Claude Code, which writes the code and commits it.
He argues this could replace WordPress for small businesses, where a small change can take an agency a week.
The demo updates a small Austin LangChain meetups site from a Google Doc, with a quality gate in the injected prompt.
Setup is a slash command that interviews you about fully autonomous sync and connecting to Vercel or GitHub.
He chose Google Docs as the plainest interface for non-technical people, and asks for feedback, for example on handling images with Google Drive links.
